mapper.sql: a.id, a.workspace_id, a.task_id, a.source_run_id, a.artifact_type, a.title, a.status, a.current_version_id, a.created_at, a.updated_at, current_version.version_number AS current_version_number, current_version.content_ref AS current_content_ref, current_version.content_format AS current_content_format, task.title AS task_title
FROM artifact a LEFT JOIN artifact_version current_version ON current_version.id = a.current_version_id LEFT JOIN task ON task.id = a.task_id
